4ecf39f1.yl: Yield: 10 steaks · Portion: ≈ 420 g (steak 220 g raw)
c: Marinate with oil, crushed garlic and thyme 2 h.
Grill very hot 2–3 min each side (rare to medium-rare only; overcooked bavette is tough); rest; slice thin across the grain.
Chop herbs, capers and anchovy; mix with mustard, vinegar and oil.
Cook halved shallots slowly in butter and sugar 25 min until soft and glossy.
4ecf39f1.st: Beef steaks to guest order: rare 50 °C, medium-rare 55 °C, medium 60 °C, medium-well 65 °C, well-done 70 °C core (after resting). Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.
4ecf39f1.al: 4 Fish (anchovy fillets) · 7 Milk (butter) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar)

d52716da.yl: Yield: 10 steaks · Portion: 200 g raw → ≈ 170 g cooked
c: Tie each steak with string to keep the shape; temper 30 min; season.
Sear in a hot pan or grill 2 min per side and on the edges.
Baste with butter, thyme and garlic; finish at 180 °C 4–6 min to core 52 °C (medium-rare).
Rest 5 min; remove string; serve with sauce (peppercorn, béarnaise, red wine).

9908bd65.yl: Yield: 5 chateaubriands × 500 g · 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 400 g
c: Cut 500 g centre pieces; tie to a cylinder.
Sear all sides 4 min; baste with butter and thyme.
Roast 180 °C to core 52 °C (12–15 min); rest 10 min; carve 6 slices at the table or pass.
Reduce vinegar with shallot and tarragon stalks to 2 tbsp; strain.
Whisk yolks with reduction over a bain-marie to ribbon (max 65 °C); whisk in warm clarified butter; add chopped tarragon.
Turn potatoes into château shapes; blanch; roast in butter 200 °C 25 min.
9908bd65.st: Beef steaks to guest order: rare 50 °C, medium-rare 55 °C, medium 60 °C, medium-well 65 °C, well-done 70 °C core (after resting). Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min. Béarnaise held at 60–63 °C max 2 h.
9908bd65.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar)

fcecfea9.yl: Yield: 10 steaks · Portion: 400 g raw bone-in → ≈ 320 g cooked
c: Beef sirloin on the bone, dry-aged
Render the fat cap on the grill first (2 min, fat down).
Grill 4 min each side; finish to order in the oven; rest 6 min.
Soak marrow in iced salted water 2 h; dice; render briefly; cool.
Beat into butter with shallot and parsley; roll; slice 20 g onto the resting steak.
fcecfea9.st: Beef steaks to guest order: rare 50 °C, medium-rare 55 °C, medium 60 °C, medium-well 65 °C, well-done 70 °C core (after resting). Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.

a169e5d9.yl: Yield: 10 steaks · Portion: 500 g raw bone-in → ≈ 400 g cooked + garnish
c: Temper 45 min; oil; season with coarse salt.
Grill on very high heat 4–5 min each side, fillet side away from the hottest bars.
Finish to order in the oven; rest 6 min.
Herb butter: butter, parsley, garlic; roll; chill; slice 15 g.
Halve tomatoes; oil; grill cut side 3 min.
a169e5d9.st: Beef steaks to guest order: rare 50 °C, medium-rare 55 °C, medium 60 °C, medium-well 65 °C, well-done 70 °C core (after resting). Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.

edd56062.yl: Yield: 10 steaks · Portion: ≈ 420 g (steak 220 g raw)
c: Remove the central sinew if present; portion 220 g.
Grill hot 3 min each side to medium-rare; rest 5 min; slice against the grain.
Chop herbs and garlic fine by hand; mix with vinegar, chilli, salt and oil; rest 30 min.
Par-boil potato chunks; roast 210 °C 35 min with oil and rosemary.
Grill spring onions 2 min until charred.
edd56062.st: Beef steaks to guest order: rare 50 °C, medium-rare 55 °C, medium 60 °C, medium-well 65 °C, well-done 70 °C core (after resting). Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.

771fe447.yl: Yield: 10 steaks · Portion: 300 g raw → ≈ 250 g cooked
c: Temper steaks 45 min at room temperature; pat dry; salt generously (1%) 40 min before or just before cooking.
Grill/sear on very hot grill (250 °C+) 3–4 min per side; turn 90° for crosshatch.
Baste with butter, crushed garlic and thyme; take off at core: rare 48 °C, medium-rare 52 °C, medium 57 °C, medium-well 63 °C, well-done 68 °C.
Rest 5–8 min on a rack (+3 °C); slice against the grain or serve whole; finish with flaky salt and pepper.
771fe447.st: Raw 0–4 °C vacuum-packed, use by label. Cook to order.
771fe447.al: 7 Milk (butter). Serve with a choice of sauce (béarnaise, peppercorn, chimichurri) and garnish.

f420b67a.yl: Yield: 10 steaks · Portion: 280 g raw → ≈ 230 g cooked
c: 10 × 280 g, 3 cm thick, 5 mm fat cap
Score the fat cap every 2 cm; temper 45 min; season.
Render the fat edge first, standing the steaks on the cap 2 min.
Grill 3 min per side for medium-rare (core 52 °C); baste with butter, rosemary and garlic.
Rest 5 min; slice 1 cm against the grain; serve fanned.

2ec8d205.yl: Yield: 5 tomahawks × 1.2 kg = 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 380 g cooked (bone-in)
c: Dry-salt 12–24 h uncovered at 0–4 °C (1% salt); temper 1 h.
Reverse sear: oven 120 °C to core 45 °C (≈ 45–60 min).
Sear on the hottest grill 2 min per side and on the edges; baste with butter, garlic and herbs; core 52 °C for medium-rare.
Rest 10 min; carve off the bone at the table/station into 1.5 cm slices; finish with flaky salt.
2ec8d205.st: Raw 0–4 °C dry-aged/vacuum by label. Cook to order.

2e906801.yl: Yield: 10 platters · Portion: ≈ 380 g (meat ≈ 280 g cooked)
c: Mix both minces with salt, cumin, pepper and sparkling water with soda; knead 5 min; rest 12 h at 0–4 °C.
Half: shape kebapcheta 12 cm × 70 g. Other half: add grated onion and parsley; shape kyufteta 70 g, flattened.
Marinate pork neck (120 g pieces) in oil, salt, pepper, onion 2–12 h; grill 5–6 min per side; core ≥ 72 °C.
Grill nadenitsa 10–12 min on medium, turning; core ≥ 72 °C.
Fry fries 175 °C 4–5 min; top with grated sirene.
Platter: 1 kebapche, 1 kyufte, 1 pork neck, 80 g nadenitsa, 150 g fries with sirene, 30 g lyutenitsa, onion-parsley salad.
2e906801.st: Mince mix 0–4 °C 48 h. Grill to order.
2e906801.al: 7 Milk (sirene). Check the nadenitsa supplier label for allergens.

ac929b77.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 3 chops (≈ 270 g raw, bone-in)
c: Marinate chops in oil, crushed garlic, chopped rosemary and zest 2 h (or overnight) at 0–4 °C.
Season with salt just before grilling.
Grill on a very hot grill 2–3 min per side to core 55–58 °C (pink); render the fat edge for 30 s.
Rest 3 min; serve with mint sauce or salsa verde.
ac929b77.st: Marinated raw 0–4 °C 48 h. Cook to order.

e3db4bc9.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 400 g (rump 200 g raw)
c: Grill fat side first 4 min, then all sides; finish 180 °C to core 57 °C; rest 8 min; slice.
Char whole aubergines on the grill until collapsed; scoop flesh; mix with tahini, lemon and garlic.
Pour boiling salted water and oil over couscous; cover 5 min; fluff with parsley.
Chop herbs and capers; mix with vinegar and oil; season.
e3db4bc9.st: Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.

c688ba9c.yl: Yield: 5 chickens · 10 portions × ½ (≈ 450 g bone-in)
c: Grill skin-side up over medium heat 20 min (lid closed); turn skin-side down 10 min to crisp; core 74 °C breast, 80 °C thigh; halve.
Boil corn 5 min; grill with butter until charred; cut each cob in half.
Mix yoghurt with grated garlic and salt.
c688ba9c.st: Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.

008daec3.yl: Yield: 10 chops · Portion: ≈ 480 g (chop 350 g raw bone-in)
c: Grill 4 min each side; finish 180 °C to core 60 °C; rest 6 min (carry-over to 63 °C, pink).
Boil and crush potatoes with oil.
Foam butter with sage; add lemon; spoon over the chop.
008daec3.st: Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.

ced321d1.yl: Yield: 10 platters · Portion: ≈ 500 g (meat ≈ 320 g cooked)
c: Marinate lamb and chicken with oil, garlic and rosemary 2 h.
Grill in order: chicken (core 80 °C), sausages (72 °C), lamb cutlets (pink), sirloin (to order).
Toast crushed pepper; flame with cognac; add jus and cream; reduce to coating.
ced321d1.st: Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.

c936aa4b.yl: Yield: 10 chops · Portion: ≈ 520 g (chop 400 g raw bone-in)
c: Grill 5 min each side; finish 170 °C to core 63 °C; rest 8 min (pork chops may be served slightly pink at 63 °C).
Reduce to a syrup; brush during the last 3 min on the grill.
Sweat onion in butter; add cabbage, grated apple, vinegar, sugar and cinnamon; braise covered 60 min; season.
c936aa4b.st: Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.
c936aa4b.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 10 Mustard (wholegrain mustard) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar)

c: Split prawns along the back with scissors; devein; keep heads and shells on.
Marinate 15 min in half the oil with garlic, chilli and parsley (no salt yet).
Grill or plancha 230 °C 2 min per side until just opaque (60 °C core); salt.
Finish with the rest of the oil, parsley and lemon. Option: salmoriglio.
Remove stalks; marinate caps with oil, garlic and thyme 30 min.
Grill gill-side down 4 min, turn 4 min; brush with butter.
Grill sliced halloumi 1 min each side.
Serve 2 caps stacked with halloumi, chimichurri, rocket and blistered cherry tomatoes.
94d426d0.st: Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min.
94d426d0.al: 7 Milk (halloumi, butter) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar). Vegetarian; vegan without halloumi and butter.

46af7ebc.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 180 g raw → ≈ 150 g
c: Pin-bone; pat very dry; brush with oil and season.
Grill presentation side down on a clean, oiled, very hot grill 3 min without moving; turn 90° for crosshatch.
Turn and cook 2–3 min to core 50–52 °C (just opaque in the centre).
Finish with chopped herbs, olive oil and charred lemon halves.

a2f8491c.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 380 g (fish 180 g raw)
c: Grill very hot 2–3 min each side to core 55 °C (just opaque, moist).
Whisk oil, lemon, herbs and garlic over warm water (salmoriglio).
Roast pepper strips and onion 200 °C 20 min; toss with capers, vinegar and sugar.
a2f8491c.st: Fish 0–2 °C, use within 24 h; cook to order.
a2f8491c.al: 4 Fish (swordfish steak) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar). Swordfish: high mercury — not recommended for pregnant women and young children.

c: Soak wooden skewers 30 min (or use metal).
Cut zucchini in 2 cm half-moons, peppers and onion in 3 cm squares; keep mushrooms whole.
Toss with oil, garlic, herbs, lemon, salt and pepper; marinate 30 min.
Thread alternating colours; grill 8–10 min on medium-high, turning, until charred and just tender; brush with marinade.
15b3c384.st: Raw skewers 0–4 °C 24 h. Grill to order or hold ≥ 63 °C max 1 h.

c: Scale, gut and rinse the fish; pat dry and score the skin twice on each side.
Season inside and out with salt and brush with olive oil.
Grill whole in the Josper (≈ 250–300 °C) about 6–8 min per side until golden and crisp; core 63 °C at the spine.
Wash and spin-dry the leaves; dress with oil and balsamic just before service.
Plate the fish with the lemon wedge and the dressed salad. Serve at once.
2819483f.st: Raw whole fish: 0–2 °C on ice, 48 h; −18 °C, 3 months. Cook to order; do not hold cooked fish. Washed leaves: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

082faa2d.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 380 g (fillet 180 g + 3 prawns)
c: Cut 180 g steaks; tie; sear 3 min each side; finish to order; rest 5 min.
Split prawns along the back; devein.
Grill shell-side down 2 min, turn 1 min; toss with garlic-chilli oil, lemon and parsley.
Beat butter with mustard, curry, garlic, anchovy and lemon; roll; chill; slice 20 g on the steak.
082faa2d.st: Beef steaks to guest order: rare 50 °C, medium-rare 55 °C, medium 60 °C, medium-well 65 °C, well-done 70 °C core (after resting). Raw meat 0–3 °C; temper 30 min before grilling; rest after cooking; serve within 10 min. Prawns cooked to order, core 63 °C.
082faa2d.al: 2 Crustaceans (tiger prawns) · 4 Fish (anchovy fillets) · 7 Milk (butter) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard, curry powder)

2a63c752.yl: Yield: 1 batch ≈ 335 g (16 × 20 g) · Portion: 20 g
c: Roll into a 4 cm log in cling film; chill at 0–4 °C until firm.
Cut into 20 g discs; place on the hot steak just before service.
2a63c752.st: Café de Paris butter: 0–4 °C, 7 days; −18 °C, 3 months.
2a63c752.al: 4 Fish (anchovy) · 7 Milk · 10 Mustard · Dijon mustard, curry powder: check label

c: Grill on high heat 6–8 min, turning, until charred in spots.
Brush with chipotle-lime butter; roll in crumbled feta; finish with coriander and a lime wedge.
e579795b.st: Blanched cobs 0–3 °C 2 days; grill to order.

c: Melt the butter in a sauteuse; sweat the shallot until translucent.
Add the cracked pepper and toast 20 s.
Deglaze with the brandy (away from the flame; flambé with care) and let the alcohol evaporate.
Add the stock and reduce by half.
Add the cream and simmer gently until the sauce coats a spoon.
Finish with the mustard, salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Hold at 63 °C or above; do not boil when reheating.
Serve 45 g per portion with beef steak, pork or duck breast.
7adcb633.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Not suitable for freezing. Reheat to 75 °C core.
7adcb633.al: 1 Gluten (barley) · 4 Fish (Worcestershire — check label) · 7 Milk · 9 Celery (stock — check label) · 10 Mustard · 14 Sulphites (Dijon — check label)

400f60b9.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 2 canoe bones · Portion: ≈ 230 g (bone-in)
c: Soak bones in salted iced water 12 h (change once) to remove blood.
Roast cut side up 220 °C 15–18 min until marrow is soft and bubbling at the edges (core 70 °C).
Pick parsley leaves; mix with thin shallot rings and capers; dress at the last moment.
Grill sourdough slices; serve with flaky salt.
400f60b9.st: Raw bones 0–3 °C 3 days; roast to order.

c: Scrub; prick; rub with oil and coarse salt.
Bake directly on the rack 200 °C 60–75 min until the skin is crisp and the centre soft (core 95 °C).
Split potatoes in a cross; squeeze open; add butter, sour cream, chives and bacon.
328f811a.st: Hold baked potatoes uncovered at 65 °C max 2 h.

c: Cut each iceberg into quarters, keeping the core; chill in iced water 10 min; drain well.
Plate a wedge; spoon over dressing; top with tomato, thin red onion, bacon and chives.
Mash half the cheese into sour cream, mayo, buttermilk and lemon; fold in the rest crumbled; season with pepper.
59f7cceb.al: 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 7 Milk (blue cheese, sour cream 20%, buttermilk)

c: Prep. Cut peeled potatoes into 1 cm fries; rinse, dry well. Grate Parmesan, chop parsley.
Blanch. Fry at 150 °C for 5–6 min until soft, no colour; drain, cool on trays.
Mayonnaise. Mix mayonnaise, truffle oil and grated garlic; keep chilled in squeeze bottle.
Fry. To order, fry at 180 °C for 2–3 min until golden and crisp; drain.
Season. Toss hot fries with salt, truffle oil, Parmesan and parsley in a steel bowl.
Plating. Paper-lined metal cone or bowl: fries piled high, extra Parmesan on top, truffle mayonnaise in ramekin alongside.
a202ea2d.st: Blanched fries: 24 h at 0–4 °C, covered Truffle mayonnaise: 72 h at 0–4 °C
